batch_script_template:
#!/bin/bash -l
#SBATCH -A ocean
#SBATCH -p aegir
#SBATCH --constraint=v1
#SBATCH --job-name=veropt_veros
#SBATCH --time=23:59:59
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --output=slurm-%j.out
#SBATCH --error=slurm-%j.err

set -e
echo "===== SLURM JOB STARTED ====="
echo "Job ID: $SLURM_JOB_ID"
echo "Node: $(hostname)"

# run from the directory this script lives in (the point dir)
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"
echo "Work dir: $(pwd)"

ml purge || true
ml --ignore-cache load miniconda/python3.11 || true
eval "$(conda shell.bash hook)" || true
conda activate /groups/ocean/nicholas/conda/envs/veropt_311 || exit 1

python - <<'PY'
import sys, veros, mpi4py
print("sys.executable:", sys.executable)
print("veros", veros.__version__)
print("mpi4py OK")
PY

NT="$SLURM_NTASKS"
if [ -z "$NT" ]; then NT=1; fi
echo "Launching Veros with $NT task(s)…"
srun -n "$NT" veros run global_4_degree.py
